questions.q: Which description best fits tinea corporis?
options: Annular scaly patch with raised edge and central clearing
questions.explanation: Active edge with central clearing is characteristic.

questions.q: Why avoid steroid-only cream in suspected tinea?
options: Masks the rash and worsens infection

questions.q: Which scenario most needs mycology before oral treatment?
questions.explanation: Nail and scalp disease need confirmation first.
